responsibility: This definition module supplies the minimal SYSTEM interface for GNU Modula-2’s tiny runtime configuration. It exports the core machine-dependent constants and low-level built-in types and operators expected by the front end and generated code—such as BITSPERBYTE, BYTESPERWORD, ADDRESS, WORD, BYTE, C size types, ADR, and TSIZE—using compiler-provided builtins and internal type substitution points so Modula-2 code can compile and link with only a skeletal target abstraction layer.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface half of the SYSTEM pair: it exports the built-in constants, low-level types, and operators through compiler-recognized declarations, whereas SYSTEM.mod is only an empty companion implementation unit.
